package repository

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// StudentLearningWorkspaceReader reads one atomic Student-owned workspace.
type StudentLearningWorkspaceReader interface {
	GetLearningWorkspace(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspace, error)
}

// StudentLearningActionContextReader resolves a trusted frozen action snapshot.
type StudentLearningActionContextReader interface {
	GetLearningActionContext(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		learningActionID string,
	) (domain.StudentLearningActionSnapshot, error)
}

type StudentLearningActionCodeContextReader interface {
	GetLearningActionCodeContext(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		learningActionID string,
	) (domain.StudentLearningActionCodeContext, error)
}

type PracticeTaskContextReader interface {
	GetPracticeTaskContext(ctx context.Context, studentID, taskInstanceID string) (domain.PracticeTaskContext, error)
}

type PracticeTeacherValidationContextReader interface {
	GetPracticeTeacherValidationContext(
		ctx context.Context,
		practice domain.PracticeTaskContext,
		learningActionID string,
	) (domain.PracticeTeacherValidationContext, error)
}

type PracticeTaskAssistanceRecorder interface {
	RecordPracticeTaskAssistance(ctx context.Context, taskInstanceID, studentID, stepID, usageID string, action domain.TeacherAction, hintLevel *int) error
}

// StudentTargetMasteryReader reads bounded current mastery for exact targets.
type StudentTargetMasteryReader interface {
	GetTargetMastery(
		ctx context.Context,
		studentID string,
		targets []domain.LearningTargetRef,
	) ([]domain.StudentTargetMastery, error)
}

// StudentLearnerOverviewReader reads the bounded projection used by a general teacher dialog.
type StudentLearnerOverviewReader interface {
	GetLearnerOverview(ctx context.Context, studentID string) (domain.StudentLearnerOverview, error)
}

type StudentLearningSessionGateway interface {
	GetLearningSession(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
	ApplyLearningSessionMetrics(ctx context.Context, studentID, sessionID string, expectedVersion int64, analytics domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary) (domain.StudentLearningSession, error)
}

type LearningAnalyticsSummaryReader interface {
	GetLearningSessionSummary(ctx context.Context, studentID, analyticsSessionID string) (domain.LearningAnalyticsSummary, error)
}

// StudentNextActionReader reads Student computed authority, never workspace inputs.
type StudentNextActionReader interface {
	GetNextAction(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error)
}
